own_problems.text: Carries a boxed warning in United States — for heart harm

fda.text: CARDIOVASCULAR DEATH Gout patients with established cardiovascular (CV) disease treated with febuxostat tablets had a higher rate of CV death compared to those treated with allopurinol in a CV outcomes study [see Warnings and Precautions (5.1) ] . 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS Gout Flares : An increase in gout flares is frequently observed after initiation of febuxostat. summary: In the United States, febuxostat carries a boxed warning, which is the strongest warning from the FDA, regarding heart harm and a higher rate of heart-related death in gout patients who already have heart disease [3][4]. The drug's label also notes that patients frequently experience an increase in gout flares when first starting treatment [4]. Based on a small computer model rather than tests on people, the drug received a high risk score for the liver and a low risk score for the heart [M].
